lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A distinct vertical alignment of four large spots is centered above the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp horizontal gradient transition from a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal side to a low-intensity shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, elongated, dark-toned silhouettes representing commensal organisms are visible near the ventral boundary and pectoral fin.
